title: Add candidate signing status view
purpose: Expose candidate signatures and production signing readiness without implying production key ceremony is complete.
scope: Render detached candidate signature files for dependency inventory, SBOM, update metadata and provenance.
Render algorithm, key id, production_key_required and fail_closed policy.
Show production signature missing as non-GA blocker when required.
Link to verification script status when present.
Avoid storing or displaying private key material.
acceptance_criteria: Candidate signatures are visible as candidate signatures only.
Missing production signature cannot be shown as production-ready.
No secret key material appears in view, support bundle or evidence.
failure_modes: Candidate hash-bound record is mislabeled production signature.
Private key path or secret value is displayed.
Production signing missing state is hidden.
